svg.title: ELECTRO-HOBBY-3D-UPDATER architecture
svg.desc: ELECTRO-HOBBY-3D-UPDATER is a thin dispatcher in Python. Each of the four ecosystems has its own updater, which finds its projects through the manifest of each repository (hydra-umc.project.json, urtc.project.json, armor.project.json and eh3d.project.json). This tool holds no discovery, install or update logic: it runs the chosen updater as a separate process, runs the four at once for a status report, shows which updater is behind GitHub and opens a window with a card per ecosystem. The dispatching is tested against a fake process runner; the status report has run for real against three ecosystems, an install once, and the hand-over to the EH3D updater has not been run against a real checkout.
